newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia money market rate rise to 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia money market rate rise to 10.8 pct.

text.p: Croatia's average money market rate rose to 10.8 percent on Wednesday from 10.2 percent, boosted by larger call money and term loans at higher prices.
Dealers said demand tripled to 39.2 million kuna. Supply was 70 million. Call money rate rose 44 basis points to 9.44 percent on settlements of 21.6 million kuna.
Overnight trade totalled 16.6 million kuna on Tuesday as four banks borrowed money to square position.
The central bank's kuna midrates firmed to 5.4270 against the dollar and 3.5587 to the German mark. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
